notes: 60 native observations; 59 accepted full-LCD/status key replays. One full-width Goto viewport retained as referenceOnly. JSON saved directly to project.
Six hyperbolic functions, inverse trig D/R/G, MathI/LineI, negative inputs, domain errors and repair were measured on exact PLUS. Hyperbolic results are independent of angle unit.

PLUS accepts atanh(0.99999999999), rejects ±1. Decimal-rational subtraction near ±1 avoids binary cancellation; negative 15-digit holdout measured independently. acosh near one uses a decimal difference and log1p, with separate 1.00000000001 and 1.000000000001 cases. This does not claim all hidden memory digits.
sinh(230.2585092) is valid, next 1e-7 increment errors. asinh(5e99) errors. Grad inverse special angles retain rational forms: asin(0.5)=100/3, acos(0.5)=200/3, atan(1)=50. Radian asin(0.5)=pi/6.
